opening.text: Laura, your personal assistant, is already at your desk organizing your schedule. She looks up with her characteristic efficiency.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: laura
segments.text: Your schedule for today is packed. Press conference at 10, committee meeting at 2, fundraiser at 7. I've moved your lunch to 1:30 so you can actually eat.

choices.text: "I don't know how you keep track of everything."

segments.speaker: laura
segments.text: She smiles at your appreciation. "It's my job to make sure you're prepared. Speaking of which, you should review the talking points Maria sent over."

segments.speaker: laura
segments.text: "Years of practice." There's a hint of something in her tone—pride, maybe, or something more personal. "Try not to be late to the press conference."

choices.text: "I'll be there. Wouldn't want to disappoint you."

segments.speaker: laura
segments.text: "I'll have your lunch ready at 1:30. Don't skip it." She gives you a look that's half professional concern, half something else.

consequences.high_attraction: Laura may have complicated feelings (power dynamic issues in Chapter 6-7)
consequences.high_trust: Laura will be exceptionally loyal and supportive
consequences.low_engagement: Laura may be less personally invested in your success
